# Diagram Inventory

All diagram source specifications live beside the phase that uses them.

| Diagram | Specification | Location |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Architecture | [architecture-spec.md](../architecture-spec.md) | `docs/architecture-*.png` |
| Admin dashboard | [admin-dashboard-spec.md](../admin-dashboard-spec.md) | `docs/dashboard-admin.png` |
| Documentation flow | [documentation-flow-spec.md](../documentation-flow-spec.md) | `docs/doc-flow.png` |
| Deployment workflow | [deployment-workflow-spec.md](../project_plan/deployment-workflow-spec.md) | `docs/deployment-workflow.png` |
| Roadmap | [roadmap-spec.md](../roadmap-spec.md) | `docs/roadmap.png` |

When a diagram changes, update its specification and the visual index in the
same change.
